summary: The Loudoun Education Foundation urges the FCC to preserve the current scope of the E-Rate program, citing potential cost impacts on local taxpayers and school budgets if eligibility were narrowed or eliminated.

claims.argument: If eligibility were narrowed, costs would shift to local taxpayers or classroom budgets
claims.evidence_quote: If that support were narrowed or eliminated, those costs would not disappear. They would shift to local taxpayers or come out of classroom budgets.
